decisions.reason: As the modular successor to the already accepted BASIC 518, it extends a proven platform and likely costs little to keep in the portfolio.
This multi-model mobile shredder line sits close to the firm's core mobile processing business, so continued market presence still offers attractive learning and sales potential.
Although more niche and less visibly established, the stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's move toward tougher, resource-saving stationary solutions and still merits retention.
After several years with limited visible commitment and overlap with the previously abandoned grinder area, the option value appears largely exhausted and resources are better redeployed.
A dedicated line of stationary single-shaft pre-shredders complements the firm's recycling portfolio well and likely remains a credible long-term offering.
